title: OpenCode Plugins & Skills Catalog
description: Schema for Jad Madi's OpenCode V2 plugins, tools, and skills ecosystem manifest.

$schema.description: URI reference to this JSON schema file.

meta.description: Metadata about the plugins catalog and repository ecosystem.

title.description: Display title of the plugins catalog.

description.description: High-level summary of what this catalog contains.

generated.description: Date when this catalog was last generated or synchronized (YYYY-MM-DD).

root.description: Absolute filesystem root path of the plugin repositories on the author's workstation.

owner.description: GitHub username or organization owning the repositories.

count.description: Total number of registered plugins and skills packs in this file.

map.description: Repository directory or project identifier representing the ecosystem map.

mapRepo.description: Public GitHub repository URL hosting this map and catalog.

url.description: Canonical public URL of the interactive showcase hub on jadmadi.net.

note.description: Policy notes regarding private versus public plugins.

installNote.description: Guidance on how to install and avoid conflicts between local symlinks and git distribution.

versioning.description: Explanation of the CalVer versioning scheme used across plugins.

plugins.description: List of OpenCode plugins, workflows, and skills packs.

pluginItem.description: An individual OpenCode plugin, tool, or skills pack definition.

name.description: URL-safe, unique kebab-case identifier for the plugin (e.g. 'model-switcher').

title.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin (e.g. 'Model Switcher').

category.description: Functional category grouping (e.g. 'Models', 'Sessions and memory', 'Autonomy and workflow', 'Safety', 'Skills pack').

summary.description: Concise summary of what the plugin does and its primary capabilities.

problem.description: The specific developer friction or workflow problem this plugin resolves.

tags.description: Taxonomy keywords and search tags for discovery.

url.description: Canonical public detail page URL on jadmadi.net.

repo.description: Public or private GitHub repository URL hosting the source code.

directory.description: Local directory name under the oc-plugins workspace.

published.description: Whether this plugin is published on the public showcase site (jadmadi.net). True for public releases; false for internal or private tooling.

installed.description: Whether this plugin is currently installed on the local machine in ~/.config/opencode/plugins/.

artifact.description: Entry point file or directory distributed for the plugin (e.g. 'model-switcher.ts', 'opencode-sila/', 'skills/').

installedPath.description: Local filesystem path where the plugin is linked or copied in ~/.config/opencode/plugins/, or null if not installed.

version.description: Current release version using CalVer YYYY.MM.MICRO (e.g. '2026.9.0').

latestTag.description: Git release tag corresponding to current version (e.g. 'v2026.9.0').

updated.description: Date when this plugin was last released or updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

license.description: Open source or proprietary software license (e.g. 'MIT').

commands.description: Custom slash commands registered by this plugin into the OpenCode TUI.

name.description: Slash command trigger including leading slash (e.g. '/model', '/free').

description.description: What the slash command does when invoked.

tools.description: Autonomous agent tool names registered with OpenCode (e.g. 'best_of_n', 'memory_search', 'task').

limits.description: Known operational constraints, environment variable overrides (e.g. MAX_MODE_MODEL, MEMORY_ROOT), and safety rules.

install.description: Instructions for manual local installation (copying or symlinking into ~/.config/opencode/plugins/).

installCommand.description: One-line OpenCode CLI install command for git distribution (e.g. 'opencode plugin add github:jadmadi/opencode-model-switcher').

previousVersion.description: Legacy semver version prior to migrating to CalVer (e.g. '0.5.2').

changelog.description: URL to the CHANGELOG.md file in the plugin's GitHub repository.

builtUnder.description: OpenCode runtime version this plugin was built and tested against (e.g. '2.0.16').

builtUnderTag.description: Git release tag marking the OpenCode runtime baseline (e.g. 'builtUnder-2.0.16').
